instruction.text: Lukas ist als Austauschschüler bei Fia in Irland. Höre dir den Dialog an und schreibe die fehlenden Wörter.

atoms.a: So, Fia... you said your family has lived around this part of Sligo for centuries?
atoms.b: So, Fia... you said your ((family)) has lived around this area in Sligo for centuries?

atoms.a: Yeah, my granddad always says we're actually related to the old O'Dowd clan. There's a really famous local legend about one of them — Thady Rua O'Dowd. Rua means red because he had bright red hair.
atoms.b: Yeah, my granddad always says we're actually ((related)) to the old O'Dowd clan. There's a really famous local legend about one of them — Thady Rua O'Dowd. Rua means ((red)) because he had bright red hair.

atoms.a: Right, so back in the day, Thady was walking along the beach near here. Suddenly, he saw a group of Selkies on the rocks.
atoms.b: Right, so back in the day, Thady was walking along the ((beach)) near here. Suddenly, he saw a group of Selkies on the rocks.

atoms.a: Wait, what's a selkie? Is that like a mermaid?
atoms.b: Wait, what's a selkie? Is that like a mermaid?

atoms.a: Kind of, but different! A selkie is a creature from Irish folklore. They look like seals in the water, but when they come onto land, they take off their seal skins and turn into beautiful humans.
atoms.b: Kind of, but different! A selkie is a creature from Irish folklore. They look like seals in the water, but when they come onto land, they take off their seal skins and turn into beautiful ((humans)).

instruction.text: Welches dieser Bilder zeigt ein Selkie? Wähle aus.

atoms.sound: Anyway, Thady fell in love with one of the selkies. When she wasn't looking, he sneaked up and stole her seal skin to hide it.

Because without her seal skin, a selkie can't return to the sea! So in her case, it meant she had to stay on land. Thady took her home, and she agreed to marry him. They lived together for years and even had children. But he kept the seal skin hidden the whole time.
That sounds sad, to be honest. Did she ever find out?
She did! Years later, one of the children found Thady checking on the seal skin and then told his mother. She immediately went to find it. The moment she touched it, the sea called her back.

instruction.text: In welcher Reihenfolge hat es sich laut Legende zugetragen? Ordne die Sätze.

atoms.text: Thady falls in love with a selkie and hides her seal skin, so she can't go back.
Thady marries the Selkie woman and has children with her.
One of their children finds the hidden seal skin.
The selkie woman goes to find her skin to return to the sea.

atoms.sound: So she just left? What about her children?
Legend says she took her children but turned most of them into stone rocks near the beach so they'd always stay near the sea, and then she went into the water and never came back.
Welcome to Irish legends, lad! Half of our stories end with someone turning into a rock or disappearing into the sea.

instruction.text: Sind die Aussagen wahr oder falsch? Wähle aus.

atoms.a: The selkie woman left her children with their father.
She turned her children into rocks so they would stay close to her.
All Irish legends deal with water creatures.
